components.title: RideTube (fork by 7amoody1985)
components.description: A modified build of JustAnotherPU's RideTube (github.com/JustAnotherPU/ridetube), not endorsed by its developer, with its own ids: it installs beside the original and never over it (only one of them plays at a time). Fixes the Search menu (and the settings in it) closing right after it opens; its service streams the video in RAM instead of writing it to the head unit's flash. Source: github.com/7amoody1985/ridetube
components.author: JustAnotherPU, modified by 7amoody1985

components.title: RideTube service (fork by 7amoody1985)
components.description: The car side of the RideTube fork (JustAnotherPU's RideTube, modified, with its own ids): yt-dlp fetches on the car, the sound through the BMW MediaPlayer, the picture decoded by ytdec. The playing video streams in RAM (a 256 MB tmpfs) instead of being written whole to the head unit's flash; a debug report in /run/mdq-ridetube-d/status.json and log/sessions.jsonl. Needs Node.js 22 from the JustAnotherPU/mgu-apps source. Source: github.com/7amoody1985/ridetube
components.author: JustAnotherPU, modified by 7amoody1985

components.title: CarLink (experimental)
components.description: Experimental. The next turn from HudHud or Google Maps on your phone, in the middle of the instrument cluster and as a home-screen widget, sent by the CarLink phone app over the car's Wi-Fi. Demo shows it without the phone. Needs cluster-render from the robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps source.
components.author: 7amoody1985

components.title: Heritage Cluster (experimental)
components.description: STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT, NOT YET TESTED IN A REAL CAR (a test in a car is coming soon). Classic X5 instrument clusters (E53, F15) shown on your car's digital cluster in place of the stock dials. For iDrive 7 with the 12.3-inch cluster; laid out for a G05 X5. Use it at your own risk: try it parked first and uninstall it if anything looks wrong.
